text:
zoe: proposal: add a "transient" mode to deploy-bot for tiny hotfixes. doesn't change pins, auto-reverts after window.

dan: sounds useful. limits?

zoe: policy idea: <=15% traffic, window <=60m unless explicit change-window. dry-run required.

michelle: CLI sketch pls

zoe: 
```
# dry-run preview
deploy-bot transient preview --svc api --image api:v3.0.1 --pct 10 --window 30m --dry-run

# apply
deploy-bot transient apply --svc api --image api:v3.0.1 --pct 10 --window 30m --note "minor fix"
```

ops-bot: auto-audit event will include transient_id, user, svc, image, pct, window. guard: no transient during blackout 03:00-04:00 UTC.

dan: rollback?

zoe: `deploy-bot transient revert --id <transient_id> --snapshot-notes`

michelle: add a tiny release brief text field for channels. templates in release-templates/transient/*.yaml.

deploy-bot: preview ok. transient-id=tx1a2b, est p95 +12ms, cost +$0.03/10k tokens.

ops-bot: roadmap: michelle writes templates, dan defines audit schema, zoe prototypes bot responses. alpha next week.
